subject.title: feat(system-agent): auto-hatch into the agent after fresh setup

question: Which typed gateway/client contract should distinguish a fresh-setup hatch from an ordinary `open-agent` handoff?
rationale: The UI cannot safely infer a one-time onboarding ceremony from the existing generic action without changing configured users’ established handoff behavior.

options.title: Add hatch-only metadata
options.body: Preserve `open-agent` semantics and carry a narrowly named hatch indicator or draft payload that the custodian page consumes only for fresh setup.

options.title: Use a new dedicated action
options.body: Introduce a separate action for setup hatch handoff and update gateway clients to handle it explicitly.

recommendation.title: Add hatch-only metadata
recommendation.body: Preserve `open-agent` semantics and carry a narrowly named hatch indicator or draft payload that the custodian page consumes only for fresh setup.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged and proposed work covers the custodian/onboarding surface and its handoff behavior.
